## File: facebookresearch_fairo/droidlet/lowlevel/minecraft/tests/test_cuberite.py

Prompts

```
['create a Cuberite work directory with a flat world config, creative mode, and specified plugins', 'launch a Cuberite Minecraft server process with a given config, seed, game mode, port, and plugins', 'ping a running Cuberite server instance on localhost to verify it is responsive', 'destroy a running Cuberite server process and verify it is no longer reachable via ping', 'test that the Cuberite server executable exists at the expected repository path']
```

Usage

```
{'create_workdir_cuberite': 'create a Cuberite work directory with a flat world config, creative mode, and specified plugins', 'launch_cuberite_process': 'launch a Cuberite Minecraft server process with a given config, seed, game mode, port, and plugins', 'ping_cuberite_server': 'ping a running Cuberite server instance on localhost to verify it is responsive', 'destroy_cuberite_process': 'destroy a running Cuberite server process and verify it is no longer reachable via ping', 'test_cuberite_executable': 'test that the Cuberite server executable exists at the expected repository path'}
```
